title: Remote foundations M1b: a supported federation enable/disable surface (settings field + verification) so the central host can be switched on and off without editing the store
outcome: Remote foundations M1b: a supported federation enable/disable surface (settings field + verification) so the central host can be switched on and off without editing the store
acceptance: A supported operator surface (POST /api/settings with a federation field, or an equally supported route) enables federation with role central on this host by calling the existing configure_federation path. The intended persisted shape is preferences.federation = {enabled, role: "central", central: <local host identity>}. The surface is validated, version- and content-fenced, and persisted durably (tests, including restart/reload).
Disable is supported through the same surface, and returns all existing local session and mailbox behaviour unchanged (tests); enabling never changes local behaviour beyond M1's documented scope.

A read surface (settings GET and/or the existing federation registry view wired to a route) shows the current federation state: enabled, role, host_id, host_generation and the registry summary, so an operator can verify the enable without reading the store (test).
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
